title: py-sdk: ack-mode streaming consumer with per-chunk idempotency and soft-resume
creator: Maya Liu
description:
Problem: customers building streaming chat integrations want stronger delivery guarantees without sacrificing simple '“for-await” ergonomics. Current SDK surface conflates transport-level streaming (SSE/websocket) with application-level idempotency and resume semantics, making retries and server-initiated reconnects error-prone.

Goal: Ship a minimal, backward-compatible consumer API for the Python SDK that exposes: (1) explicit ack-mode semantics (auto-ack, manual-ack, lease-based ack), (2) per-chunk idempotency tokens and deterministic checkpoint markers, (3) a soft-resume flow that prefers client-side replay from cached KV when available but falls back to server resume token when needed, and (4) middleware hooks for telemetry and user-facing cancellation/backpressure. The feature should support both hosted and private deployments with identical behavior.

Design highlights (decisions and trade-offs):
- Ack modes: default remains auto-ack to preserve existing ergonomics, add ManualAck context manager for strong-at-least-once semantics, and LeaseAck for a time-window lease useful for long-running consumers. ManualAck requires callers to call ack(chunk_id) before advancing checkpoints; LeaseAck obtains a short-lived lease token from the runtime and renews automatically when keepalive is enabled.
- Idempotency envelope: every emitted chunk will include a stable idempotency_key generated server-side; clients may optionally include an idempotency_key on send. SDK will attach a lightweight local cache (LRU by conversation id) to dedupe re-delivered chunks during resume. This avoids forcing users to build outdedicated dedupe logic.
- Soft-resume flow: when the connection drops, the SDK will attempt: (1) local replay from the LRU KV up to the last confirmed checkpoint, (2) if local replay cannot satisfy missing tokens or the gap is > N bytes, request server resume using the last known resume_token. This hybrid approach reduces round trips for small interruptions while preserving correctness for larger gaps.
- Backpressure and consumer window: introduce a consumer window semaphore (configurable) combined with a per-message cost estimator (chars + attachments) to throttle prefetch. This keeps tail latency predictable under bursty traffic.
- Telemetry hooks: add on_chunk_received, on_resume_attempt, on_ack, on_leak_detected callbacks. Instrumentation must emit tokenized metrics compatible with Console dashboards (route, model, ack_mode, consumer_window).

Compatibility: The public ChatStreamingClient API remains source-compatible. New constructs: ManualAckContext, LeaseAckConfig, StreamingCheckpoint (opaque string), and checksummed idempotency_key on chunks. We will add graceful deprecation notes for any helper that touched resume internals.

Acceptance criteria:
- Feature gated behind a minor version flag in the SDK (opt-in by config) for the initial rollout.
- Unit + integration tests for auto/manual/lease ack flows including replays, duplicate delivery, and server-issued resume_token path.
- End-to-end smoke tested against hosted staging and a private VPC deployment (on-prem simulator).
- Documentation: quickstart showing ManualAck usage for transactional consumers, and a cookbook on when to choose LeaseAck.
- Example app: small sample in examples/ack-mode-consumer.py demonstrating manual ack + telemetry hooks and backpressure tuning.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: full end-to-end exactly-once semantics (requires server-side transactional guarantees) and cross-conversation sharding logic. Those will be follow-ups if uptake is high.
comments: 2026-02-18 Maya Liu: Initial write-up and proposal. Sketches for ManualAck and LeaseAck included. Raised concern about server resume token format — flagged for API compatibility review.

2026-02-22 Arjun Patel: Implementation spike completed. Prototype local LRU dedupe works. Observed memory growth with naive cache when conversation ids have highly variable retention; switched to bounded LRU with size- and time-based eviction.
2026-02-28 Ethan Cole: Reviewed approach for consumer window throttling. Suggested a cost-estimator plugin interface (pluggable) rather than hardcoding chars-only. Added label 'backpressure'.

2026-03-03 Priya Nambiar: Security review: ack tokens and resume tokens must not be logged in plaintext. Added masking requirement and telemetry scrub policy. Marked security_review_required=false here but will file separate security follow-up for KMS usage of resume token rotation.

2026-03-08 Lina Gomez: Integration test run against staging failed on flaky resume path when gap detection threshold default was too small. Increased default gap threshold from 512 bytes to 2 KB and added a tunable config value.

2026-03-12 Arjun Patel: PR opened (see attachments). Added examples/ack-mode-consumer.py and docs/cookbooks/ack-mode.md. Running CI; two flaky tests remaining around LeaseAck renewal under severe GC pressure. Allocated timebox to harden renewal with jittered backoff.
